user_story: As a guest, I want to retrieve a booking that does not exist to return a not-found error so that I know the ID is invalid.

positive.title: Retrieve a non-existent booking ID and receive a not-found error
steps: Step 1: Open the booking retrieval interface.
Step 2: Enter a booking ID that does not exist in the system.
Step 3: Submit the request to retrieve the booking.
positive.expected_result: A not-found error is returned indicating that the booking ID is invalid.

negative.title: Retrieve a booking with a null ID value
steps: Step 1: Open the booking retrieval interface.
Step 2: Enter a null value in the booking ID field.
Step 3: Submit the request to retrieve the booking.
negative.expected_result: The system returns an error indicating that the booking ID cannot be null.

edge.title: Retrieve a booking with a very long booking ID
steps: Step 1: Open the booking retrieval interface.
Step 2: Enter a very long booking ID that exceeds typical lengths (e.g., 256 characters).
Step 3: Submit the request to retrieve the booking.
edge.expected_result: The system handles the input gracefully and returns a not-found error or a proper input validation error message.
